Q: How to reuse one things everywhere? A:

Please explain why and when we use the @Override and the method to use the class in interface

You use @Override when you're overriding a method from a class you're extending, or implementing a method from an interface.

You actually don't have to - the code will still compile without it. It's merely good practice to indicate that this method overrides/implements something else.

also the generic class.

You don't have a generic class in the question.

Q: How to specify a variable amount of whitespace as the CSV import Sqlite separator? A:

You can't.

Because you don't have CSV, TSV etc!

You were thinking of

$ perldoc -f split
    split /PATTERN/

But that's not the same concept.

So you need to first convert your file, using, e.g., perl, awk, or simply tr -s ' ' as suggested in a comment. And then only after you get it into CSV, TSV, etc. format, import it into SQLite.
